title: Facebook Ad Engagement in the Russian Active Measures Campaign of 2016
reasoning: The paper conducts a feature analysis to determine what makes disinformation ads engaging. One of the key sociolinguistic features analyzed is 'Religion,' which captures the use of religion-related words. The study finds that this feature is highly important for predicting engagement, ranking it as a top feature for multiple machine learning models. An example ad provided in the paper explicitly uses religious imagery (Jesus vs. Satan) to solicit user interaction. This direct analysis of how religious language and themes are used to drive engagement in a disinformation campaign is a core component of the research.
